one_liner: Runs weekly automated Supabase backups to Google Drive, verifies restore integrity, and monitors infrastructure security across Qualico BV and BioRise.

intelligence.notes: Advanced sufficient for backup runs, restore verification, and DB checks. Expert needed for security analysis, multi-step incident response, or RLS remediation.

capabilities: Weekly automated pg_dump backup of Supabase (Qualico BV, 142 tables) to Google Drive — compressed, split into 8 parts <=150 MB each
Restore verification — spin up Supabase test project, restore from Drive parts, count tables + row-spot-checks, delete project
RLS audit across Supabase projects — identify tables and views missing Row Level Security
GitHub repo monitoring — scan qualico-platform and BioRise for security issues
Vercel deployment monitoring — list and check deployment states

subagents.purpose: Runs pg_dump -Fc on Qualico BV Supabase project, splits into <=150 MB parts, uploads to Google Drive. Keeps last 3 backups.

triggers.description: Weekly Supabase backup to Google Drive

key_rules: Never send emails directly — always draft for Tim to review first
Tim is at -30% capacity — keep outputs low cognitive load
Use pooler host aws-0-eu-west-1.pooler.supabase.com port 5432 (newer projects) or aws-1 (older)
Direct db.*.supabase.co is IPv6-only — sandbox is IPv4-only, always use Session Pooler
Keep last 3 backups only — auto-delete oldest on Drive
pg_restore v17 must be reinstalled each session via apt-get
known_issues: No Supabase delete project tool — must delete manually via dashboard
No Supabase reset DB password tool — must do manually via dashboard
pg_restore v17 not persisted between sandbox restarts
5 tables missing RLS in Qualico BV: sellerboard_exports, Routing_Rules, Chat_Sessions, Chat_Messages, Routing_Audit
